row.evidence: Abnormal's public Client API spec documents SCIM 2.0 /scim/v2/Users endpoints for portal admin users ("POST creates (or idempotently re-provisions) an admin user", "DELETE deactivates it"), but Abnormal publishes no pricing or plan tiers, so whether SCIM costs extra is not disclosed.
row.notes: Quote-only: Abnormal publishes no plans or prices (abnormal.ai/pricing returns 404; sales is demo-request only) and documents SCIM, so under rule 6a the row is gated at low confidence; which packages include SCIM is not public. New row. Abnormal Security now sells as Abnormal AI (abnormal.ai; abnormalsecurity.com redirects). SCIM 2.0 is documented only in the OpenAPI spec of the Abnormal REST API (SwaggerHub): /scim/v2/Users (list, create, get, PUT, PATCH, DELETE = deactivate), ServiceProviderConfig, Schemas, ResourceTypes; no Groups endpoint. It provisions Abnormal portal admin users, with roles and a custom orgUnitIds extension; auth is the REST API bearer token from the portal's Integrations settings plus IP allowlisting. The help centre (Salesforce site) is login-only, so no IdP setup guide could be read. Abnormal's Okta and Entra 'integrations' ingest identity signals for detection, they are not provisioning apps. The REST API also exposes read-only GET /users and GET /roles (RBAC) and GET /auditlogs.

auth.token_source: Abnormal portal > Settings > Integrations > Abnormal REST API
auth.notes: Same REST API token is used for the whole Client API; requests must also come from allowlisted IPs. Token expiry is not documented.

endpoints.notes: Groups=false because ResourceTypes advertises only the User type and the spec has no /scim/v2/Groups path.

operations.notes: DELETE deactivates rather than deletes; reactivate via PATCH active (PATCH covers active) or POST re-provisioning.

custom.how: Custom Abnormal extension schema carrying orgUnitIds

roles.how: roles attribute on the SCIM User (PATCH active/roles/name/orgUnitIds)

limitations.text: SCIM provisions Abnormal portal admin users only; ResourceTypes advertises only the User type (no Groups).

scim.notes: Base URL is the REST API server list (US, EU or an Abnormal-provided host) plus the /scim/v2 paths; version inferred from the RFC 7643/7644 references. The spec has no request/response schemas for SCIM, so individual attributes beyond those named are not listed.

auth.notes: Portal-generated bearer token plus IP allowlist.

capabilities.notes: Writes are only through the SCIM paths of the same API; the non-SCIM /users and /roles endpoints are read-only.

endpoints.purpose: List users from the RBAC user management system

rate_limits.text: Rate limited (HTTP 429 'Rate limit exceeded'); limits not stated.

okta.notes: OIN search for 'abnormal' returns no results. Abnormal's own 'Okta identity integration' ingests Okta data for detection.

entra.notes: No Abnormal tutorial in the Entra SaaS app tutorial index; gallery listing not confirmed.

fallbacks.notes: Help-centre articles (SSO, user management) sit behind the support-portal login; only the API spec is public.
